newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Road accidents kill seven a day in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Road accidents kill seven a day in Morocco.

text.p: An average of seven people a day died in road accidents in Morocco in the first eight months of the year, the Moroccan news agency MAP said on Wednesday.
MAP said the total number of people killed in the first eight months of the year was 1,708, down from the 2,140 people who died in the same period in 1995.
Morocco, with a population of about 27 million and more than one million cars, has one of the world's worst accident rates.
